turns.question: How many delivery-topic customer service calls were there per 100 shipped orders in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no calls-per-100-shipped-orders metric, so I can't give that ratio; the closest metrics give 1 delivery-topic call (Calls labelled, model-derived topic) and 50 shipped orders (Orders, status shipped) for 1 to 30 September 2026.
